label: Family Care Coordination Team
blurb: A Family Care Coordinator and 4 specialists who coordinate shared caregiving tasks, appointments, and family updates
purpose: Created for individuals, families, and organizers looking for dedicated support with family care coordination. Coordinate shared caregiving tasks, appointments, and family updates. The team takes care of preparation, detailed planning, and practical follow-through to keep everything running smoothly.

project.name: Family Care Coordination
project.goal: Deliver a comprehensive initial family care coordination plan with clear milestones, assigned responsibilities, and verified outputs.
